approved_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (independent code-reviewer agent, fresh context per review round)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Schema file is valid JSON Schema (2020-12 meta-schema)
acceptance_criteria.verification: Validate the schema file against the JSON Schema meta-schema

stop_conditions: Scope expansion beyond the single schema file and its fixtures
rollback: Delete schemas/v2/ entirely; no other file depends on it yet.
invalidation_rules: Base revision changes underneath the lease
unauthorized_extra_field: should be rejected by additionalProperties: false at the top level
